'''Proculus Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire. It was the only official way to reach the planet's surface, as visitors to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world were required to dock at the station and take a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] down to the surface.
